data.title: SF Startup Behind ‘Robot-Dog Walkers Wanted’ Ad Gets Visit, Threatening Texts From Angry Resident
data.description: An SF startup is training AI agents to control robots independently through the use of paid "robot-dog walkers," and the project has already drawn threatening messages and a visit to the company's office from a disgruntled resident.
data.site_name: SFist - San Francisco News, Restaurants, Events, & Sports
